name: Taimanin Kurenai
source:
Prepare for a demon-slaying tale heretofore untold!
She is Taimanin, clad in shadow... The so-called "Crimson Princess Annihilator"...
A half-vampire burdened by a destiny of blood and darkness,
she fights daily to extinguish evil---
Her name is Kurenai. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162925.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
准备好迎接迄今为止未曾讲述过的斩妖故事吧！
她就是披着阴影的对魔忍……所谓的“红红公主歼灭者”……
一个背负着血与黑暗命运的半吸血鬼，
她每天都在为消灭邪恶而奋斗——
她的名字叫红。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE162925.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
